purpose: Identify a geometry-preserving high-resolution research image candidate without ingesting or publishing the image itself.

candidate.source: 集古作網・馮承素《摹蘭亭序》卷（神龍本）
candidate.reason: The page reports an ultra-high-resolution full-scroll raster and identifies the same Palace Museum object dimensions. It is suitable as a research registration candidate, but it is not promoted to authoritative geometry until the writing field, 28 original lines, and object landmarks are checked against the official museum record.
candidate.storagePolicy: Do not commit or publish the source raster. Store only source reference, derived normalized measurements, provenance, and research annotations.

negativeControl.source: 蘭木・神龍本數字復刻
negativeControl.reason: The site explicitly states that the original 28 irregular lines were rearranged into 27 lines of 12 characters; it cannot supply spatial evidence.

requiredChecks: Confirm the raster preserves the complete writing field rather than a reconstructed typeset sequence.
Recover exactly 28 original writing lines, with 13 on the front paper and 15 on the back paper.
Locate the two-paper join and compare its position with the museum description.
Register normalized writing-field coordinates independently of seals, mounting and later colophons.
Bind transcription to line IDs before glyph boxes are created.
Retain complete parent-line geometry for every isolated glyph measurement.

promotion.B-registered-to-image-bound-evidence: target glyph and parent line are measured and cross-checked against the official object record

nextGate: Register the candidate raster to the 28-line object geometry, identify the exact parent lines for 是 and 和, then record normalized line and glyph boxes.
